title: Analytic: impedance-matched magnetic absorber (mu_r, sigma_m; E_z and H_z FDTD)
description:
A 1 um slab with eps_r = mu_r = 2 and electric plus magnetic loss chosen so that sigma_m / (mu0 mu_r) = sigma_e / (eps0 eps_r) sits in a y-periodic vacuum strip with CPML along x. Both polarisations run at once (physics 'em' = em_fdtd_ez, 'em_hz' = em_fdtd_hz), each launched by a one-sided mode source (the plane wave of the periodic strip, toward +x).
Analytic: the slab impedance equals eta0 at every frequency, so nothing is reflected (R = 0) and the transmission is frequency-flat: T = exp(-2 sigma_e eta0 sqrt(mu_r / eps_r) d) = e^-2 = 0.1353 (amplitude decay sigma_e eta0 sqrt(mu_r / eps_r) per m).
Spectra tab: em.trans / em_hz.trans quantity fraction_positive (transmission) and em.refl / em_hz.refl (upstream of the source) quantity fraction_negative (reflection) over 0.8-1.3 um vs the dashed flat lines.
Derived values tab: R_ez, R_hz (absolute, reference 0) and T_ez, T_hz at 1 um.
Expected agreement: T ~0.3 % (discrete loss terms, numerical dispersion). R_hz should stay well below R_ez (H_z at the cell centres takes the mu of its own cell, the E faces average eps across the slab faces: no half-cell offset). R_ez is larger, an estimated 2-4e-4: the E_z type's H_x / H_y faces take mu_r and sigma_m of their lower cell, so its magnetic slab sits half a cell (+x) off the electric one and each slab face is a 5 nm unmatched layer (R grows as 1 / lambda^2); tolerance 1e-3 absolute, to be confirmed by a first run.

parameters.name: d_slab
parameters.description: slab thickness (100 cells, faces on cell edges)

parameters.name: alpha_target
parameters.description: field decay rate [1/m]: T = exp(-2 alpha d) = e^-2

parameters.name: sigma_m_slab
parameters.description: magnetic conductivity [Ohm/m]: sigma_m / (mu0 mu_r) = sigma_e / (eps0 eps_r)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length (cpml on both x faces)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (33 cells per slab wavelength at the top of the band)

parameters.name: x_refl
parameters.description: reflection mode monitor (cell centre, upstream of the source)

parameters.name: x_trans
parameters.description: transmission mode monitor (cell centre, behind the slab)

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: pulse centre wavelength = wavelength of the derived values

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration: pulse (~20 fs) and transit past both monitors
